modules.name: rv32i5
modules.description: Top-level connection and global control only. Instantiates I/D caches, fetch/decode, branch predictor, rename/issue/ALU/LSU/ROB/PRF/commit, wires the frozen internal contracts, exposes the exact §A external ports, holds dbg_features=3'b111, maintains the 2-bit global flush_epoch (reset=0, increments on branch flush or ECALL-pending start), and masks debug events when rst_n=0 or halted=1. No duplicate pipeline timing logic in top.

modules.name: icache
modules.description: 256-byte direct-mapped 16-line/16-byte I-cache with 4-word refill FSM. Owns I-cache valid/tag/data install, CPU request/response handshake, epoch-tagged response discard, branch-flush cancellation of unaccepted requests, stable imem valid/address during wait, reset clearing all valid bits, and halted idle/address hold behavior. Outputs idle only when no accepted refill remains and no external request is outstanding.

modules.name: if_stage

notes: Frozen contract: 6-bit physical-register tags (PR0=x0 permanently ready and zero; free list starts PR32..PR39, initial map PR1..PR31=x1..x31), 4-bit ROB/LSQ/checkpoint indexes (8 ROB entries, 8 checkpoints, 8 IQ entries, 2 LSQ entries), and 2-bit flush_epoch. Internal encodings to duplicate as localparams in each file (no package/include): pred_type 00=none,01=conditional,10=JAL,11=JALR; mem_size 00=byte,01=half,10=word; wb_sel 000=ALU,001=PC+4,010=load,011=LUI/imm,100=AUIPC/pc+imm; alu_op codes 0 ADD,1 SUB,2 SLL,3 SLT,4 SLTU,5 XOR,6 SRL,7 SRA,8 OR,9 AND,10 PASS_B/imm,11 BEQ,12 BNE,13 BLT,14 BGE,15 BLTU,16 BGEU,17 JAL,18 JALR,19 LUI,20 AUIPC. Timing responsibility split: reset is synchronous and local in every stateful module plus top global epoch/debug masking; structural hazards are expressed by rename_unit combining rob_alloc_ready/iq_disp_ready/lsu_disp_ready; register dependency and load-use-equivalent waits are owned by rename_unit ready bits, issue_queue wakeup and load_store_unit in-order memory wakeup (no separate hazard_unit); branch/ECALL redirect flush selection is owned by reorder_buffer, checkpoint restore/free-list repair by rename_unit, and younger IQ/LSU clearing by their own squash logic; ECALL pending/serialization is owned by reorder_buffer (no younger dispatch after ECALL allocated) and final halted/exit_code timing by commit_unit; store write-through waiting and store_done are owned by load_store_unit/dcache with ROB holding the store at head; I/D refill and bus-stable waiting are owned by icache/dcache. Commit_unit waits for top-computed bus_idle=icache.idle && dcache.idle before raising halted, so no accepted I/D request is still outstanding. flush_epoch wraps; caches/LSU use in-flight valid plus rob-index/request-epoch identity (not epoch equality alone) to discard only younger work.
